headline: Approved Interim Chief Financial Officer Contract and Consent Agenda; reviewed FY2027 financial reporting plan and capital improvement updates.
summary: The Committee met in executive session on personnel items, then reconvened in open session. It approved the Consent Agenda, including minutes, purchase orders, homeschool requests, and a fundraiser, and approved the Interim Chief Financial Officer Contract. It also accepted a plan for FY2027 budget-to-actual monthly reporting, reviewed the FY2026 year-end financial results, discussed the Capital Improvement Plan for FY2027, and received an update on construction of the new South Kingstown High School and Curtis Corner athletic complex.
decisions: Sealed the minutes of the Executive Session.
Approved the Consent Agenda, including executive and open session minutes, purchase orders over $10,350, homeschool requests, and the SKHS Football fundraiser.
Approved the Interim Chief Financial Officer Contract.
Accepted Mr. Ferrucci's recommendation for FY 2027 Budget to Actual Monthly Reporting.
